keyPoints: Ghan (cube) sankhya ko khud se teen baar guna karne par milta hai — 4^3 = 64.
Ghan sankhya ka antim ank kuch bhi ho sakta hai — 2^3 = 8, 7^3 = 343, isliye varg jaisa niyam nahi lagta, jaise 3^3 = 27 aur 8^3 = 512.
Hardy-Ramanujan sankhya 1729 do tarikon se do ghanon ka yog hai: 1^3 + 12^3 = 9^3 + 10^3.
Ghanmul (cube root) ghan ka ulta hai — 64 ka ghanmul 4; ghanmul ka chihn vargmul jaisa par 3 wala hota hai.
Abhajya gunankhand se ghanmul: teen-teen ke samooh banao, har samooh se ek lo — 3375 ka ghanmul = 3 x 5 = 15 — har samooh se ek-ek gunankhand lo.
Rinatmak sankhya ka ghanmul rinatmak hota hai — (-27) ka ghanmul -3, kyunki (-3)^3 = -27.
Aam galti: ghanmul me jode banana — vargmul me jode bante hain, ghanmul me teen-teen ke samooh bante hain.
subject: Maths
title: Ghan aur Ghanmul
